Loan 3263: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 06 Jun 2024

Progress Toward Outcome: The project was completed by 30 June 2022. There are total 21 civil works contracts and 23 equipment contracts awarded under the project. As of 20 July 2022, cumulative contract awards are $143.54million, and cumulative loan disbursement is $147.24million.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jun 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/46063/46063-002-apfs-en_5.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Sep 2019: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/46063/46063-002-iee-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Sep 2019: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/46063/46063-002-rp-en_2.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Sep 2022: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/46063/46063-002-smr-en_10.pdf
Status of Implementation Progress: The project was completed by 30 June 2022. The loan account will be financially closed when the advance account is fully liquidated.
